## Scoped result

Adds the unchanged full candidate proof for OWR-14299911-031, rank 924: at least three fixed nontrivial finitely generated factors, fixed finite inverse-closed generating alphabets (including fixed-radius word balls), and fixed 1/3 < d < 1; property (T) with probability tending to one through all integer relator lengths. The broader two-factor Question 1.9 is excluded.

Two independent AI mathematical reviews accept the exact 19,961-byte proof, SHA256 `3bed7a81c5562d793bc4991fe62e1c06703818a9046495a7fe96d0b38e1ac100`, without a correction. The author proof's historical pending-audit wording is preserved; separate publication acceptance records the later audits. No exhaustive novelty, formal verification, human peer review, or journal acceptance is claimed.

## Artifacts and checks

- Preserves all three immutable safe archives and external manifests, plus exact readable copies of the proof and both full mathematical reviews.
- Adds a separately pinned fail-closed wrapper: 8,583 bytes, SHA256 `11ca693b078d4616b34af6d340327b6dfc262d995a2f1c73b2b1bd4ff1f44eeb`.
- Local relocated Python `-I -B` normal/optimized replay reproduced all three finite-check outputs and full provenance checks; all expected mathematical/provenance rejections and ten publication-integrity controls passed. Finite checks do not certify the asymptotic theorem.
- Full exact-head downloaded-body and ZIP-member verification is recorded separately after publication. CI status will be checked for this head; an absence of checks is not a passing CI result.

## Change scope

15 files under `random_property_t_30006628/` and `unsolved_math_prioritization/QUEUE.md`. The queue changes only this problem's Status (`claimed_solved`), Turns (`1/5`), and qualified Findings cells. All unrelated queue bytes, notes and existing chat links are preserved. This is one substantive proof approach; review and publication checks add no proof-search turns.

Authored mathematics/code/audits and permitted public verification metadata only. No source PDFs, dataset contents, extracted third-party source text, private sources, personal data, or coordination material are added.

Draft only. No merge, release, DOI, or outreach.
